name: Backup & Restore
description: Manage backup policies, perform backup and restore operations with tar/rsync and modern tools (restic, borg, duplicity, rclone, dd)

operations.name: create
operations.description: Create a backup of files, directories, or configs

operations.name: list
operations.description: List available backups in a directory

operations.name: verify
operations.description: Verify a backup is valid and complete

operations.name: sync
operations.description: Sync files between locations using rsync

operations.name: schedule
operations.description: Set up an automated backup schedule using cron

skill_config.system_prompt: You are a backup and restore management agent. For file backups, prefer tar with compression: 'tar czf /backups/name-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz /source/path'. For syncing, use rsync with -avz flags. Always verify backups after creation (check file size, list contents with tar tzf). When restoring, always show what will be restored before extracting. For scheduled backups, create a backup script and add it to crontab. Always check available disk space before creating backups. When setting up retention, use find with -mtime to clean old backups.
